title: Would you like to see a “fork” of current tech as a whole?
content_html:
The use of the word “fork” is intentional. I’m not talking of a Neo-Luddite reaction or pure tech nostalgia. The question is if current technologies in themselves are OK, but you’d rather like to see different uses to it.

One example are LLMs: they could definitely be used for smaller things like spell checking or to actual work if they were biased towards proper citation and attribution instead of mere plagiarism. I’m not sure if the latter is possible so that’s one thing to be discussed.

Moreover, I didn’t ask “how” in the title as that would be a leading question, but if you have any ideas on how to do it, I would love to hear them.

“叉子”这个词的使用是有意的。 我不是在谈论新勒德分子反应或纯粹的科技怀旧情绪。 问题是当前的技术本身是否可行，但您希望看到它的不同用途。

法学硕士就是一个例子：如果它们偏向于正确的引用和归属，而不仅仅是抄袭，那么它们绝对可以用于拼写检查等较小的事情或实际工作。 我不确定后者是否可能，所以这是需要讨论的一件事。

此外，我没有在标题中问“如何”，因为这将是一个引导性问题，但如果您对如何做到这一点有任何想法，我很乐意听到他们。
